aliases.name: Visa
aliases.notes: Named as Part 8 counterparty on cp_filing_0004.

notes: Card network identified on form as the counterparty for two of Ivanka Trump's credit card balances on cp_filing_0004 (items 12 and 13). Per Fork F §4 Decision Q2: the actual creditor is the issuing bank (Chase, Bank of America, AmEx-branded Visa, etc.), which is not disclosed on the form. Visa Inc. is the form-named counterparty and registered for transcription fidelity; if a future filing or research step identifies the issuing bank, the entity can be renamed or split at that point.
